reason: The README documents a vision_analyze tool whose primary purpose is sending images to an OpenAI-compatible vision model and returning textual analysis, so it is classified as a media tool with external API usage.

summaries.zh: 通过兼容 OpenAI API 的视觉模型分析本地图片或图片 URL，并根据问题返回文字结果。
summaries.en: Analyze local images or image URLs with an OpenAI-compatible vision model and return a text response to a question.

capabilities: Sends a local image path or HTTPS/data URL to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision model
Returns text generated by the vision model in response to a user question
Supports configurable API credentials, endpoint, model, and request timeout
